scripts.build: pnpm build:discovery && pnpm build:sitemap && astro build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['sitemap-index.xml','sitemap-0.xml'])fs.rmSync('dist/'+f,{force:true})"
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @seo/web... build && pnpm secrets:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply seo-telemetry --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.preview:cloudflare: PUBLIC_DISABLE_TURNSTILE_FOR_LOCAL_PREVIEW=true pnpm build && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply seo-telemetry --local && wrangler dev --var LOCAL_TOOL_PREVIEW:true
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs src/lib/*.test.ts worker/index.test.ts worker/tools/*.test.ts && node scripts/sitemap-extractor-resource-harness.mjs
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false --check && astro check && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json
